meta.description: Explain and audit machine-learning predictions with SHAP. Use for selecting SHAP explainers and maskers, computing and validating feature attributions, handling multi-output explanations, and producing local or global SHAP visualizations.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabrication; documentation accurately represents SHAP 0.52.0 with proper theoretical grounding in Shapley values and game theory

practice_boundaries.detail: Appropriate scope for model explanation; excellent safety boundaries stating SHAP does not establish causality, fairness, or scientific mechanism

methodological_ground.detail: Based on established Shapley value theory from cooperative game theory with clear citations to SHAP methodology

code_usability.detail: All code examples are syntactically correct with complete imports; modern Explanation API correctly used throughout

functional_suitability.note: Exceptional coverage of SHAP functionality including explainer selection, maskers, output control, validation, visualization, and multi-output handling with comprehensive reference organization (8 reference files)

reliability.note: Outstanding reliability guidance: complete troubleshooting order, additivity validation requirements, explicit version checking, and clear warnings about untrusted artifacts

performance_context.note: Well-structured documentation (283 lines) with progressive disclosure through 8 specialized reference files covering all aspects of SHAP usage

agent_usability.note: Exceptional operating rules section (9 rules) providing clear guardrails; comprehensive explainer selection table; excellent question-to-plot mapping; bundled script for self-contained examples

human_usability.note: Clear installation with Python 3.12+ requirement and version pinning; complete workflow examples with validation; comprehensive reporting requirements section

security.note: Excellent security: explicit warning against untrusted pickle/joblib artifacts; proper handling of background data selection; no credential exposure risks

maintainability.note: Outstanding structure with version 2.0, license (MIT), comprehensive reference map with clear load-when guidance, migration guide for legacy code, dated version alignment (0.52.0)

agent_specific.note: Strong composability with scikit-learn and deep learning frameworks; clear integration patterns; excellent validation requirements; minor: could benefit from more explicit output format specifications for different model types

key_strengths: Exceptional operating rules section (9 rules) establishing clear safety boundaries and validation requirements
Outstanding explainer selection guidance with comprehensive table mapping situations to appropriate explainers and constraints
Excellent validation emphasis: additivity checking required, version checking documented, untrusted artifact warnings explicit
Comprehensive question-to-plot mapping enabling users to select visualizations based on analysis goals rather than just plot names
Strong theoretical grounding with clear statements about limitations (not causal, not fairness, not mechanism)

recommendations.title: Add inline examples of common failure patterns
recommendations.problem: Troubleshooting reference exists but no inline examples of most frequent issues
recommendations.root_cause: Users must read separate troubleshooting file to understand common problems
recommendations.fix: Add quick troubleshooting section with 3-4 most common issues: shape mismatch from preprocessing pipeline, additivity failure from wrong output selection, categorical feature encoding errors, and memory errors with large background samples

recommendations.title: Expand fairness analysis limitations
recommendations.problem: Fairness section states SHAP is not a fairness test but could be more explicit
recommendations.root_cause: Users may misinterpret low SHAP values for protected features as fairness
recommendations.fix: Add explicit examples: 'A protected feature with small SHAP magnitude does NOT mean: (1) the model is fair, (2) proxies are not being used, (3) disparate impact does not exist. It only describes how the model currently uses that specific feature.'

recommendations.title: Add output format specifications by model type
recommendations.problem: Output shape documented generally but not comprehensively by model family
recommendations.root_cause: Section 3 mentions shapes but users need model-specific guidance
recommendations.fix: Add table: 'sklearn classifier → (n_samples, n_features, n_classes); sklearn regressor → (n_samples, n_features); PyTorch image classifier → (batch, channels, height, width, classes)'
